deploy-bot: Deployment started — id=deploy-1794300120 env=dedicated-us-west-2/private-cluster-3 tag=release-v2.14.0 commit=ae3f4b2 initiator=maria strategy=canary(5%) change-window=2026-03-20T03:00-04:00
maria: Starting canary rollout for v2.14.0 — watch health & latency for 10m. Tagged as 'hotfix-metrics' because this touches observability.
chris: ack. I'll monitor traces and error rate. Noting dedicated pool quota bumped for this window.
ops-bot: autoscaler: pool dedicated-us-west-2 scaled +2 gpus for burst 
deploy-bot: Canary step complete — 5% traffic -> healthy. Health checks: 4/4. latency_p50=110ms latency_p95=320ms
samir: p95 320ms vs baseline ~280ms. small regress but could be noise. saw one 503 in canary logs: `req_id=3f9b2a`
maria: I see the 503, digging into logs. Could be seq-length handling in prompt chunker. Holding before next step.
chris: If we hold >10m we should consider pinning the previous release on the dedicated pool so production doesn't auto-promote. any objections?
samir: No objections. If needed pin `release-v2.13.7` on dedicated-us-west-2.
maria: Agree. I'll shift canary back to stable variant and run a narrower repro.
deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated — target=release-v2.13.7 rollback_id=deploy-1794300120-rollback started_by=maria reason="503s + p95 regression"
deploy-bot: Rollback complete — all canary traffic shifted to release-v2.13.7. Health checks steady. commit pinned: release-v2.13.7
chris: Nice quick response. Maria — want a postmortem or just a bug for seq-len handling? I can open a ticket.
maria: Please open a bug and I'll attach the canary logs and a reproducer. Root cause looks like trailing-token concatenation in the chunker.
samir: Also saw a small bump in tokens used during the test — cost impact minimal but worth noting for Optimize.
ops-bot: Note: change window remains locked until 04:00. Manual overrides require eng-oncall approval.
noah: If we change the patch we should stage a private-only deploy (no canary) then promote to canary. Proposal: v2.14.1-private -> e2e on private cluster -> canary.
maria: Sounds good. I'll prepare a private deploy with `--disable-concat-optimizer` and run smoke + traces. ETA ~20m.
maria: command I'll run:
```
redwood deploy --env private-cluster-3 --tag release-v2.14.1 --commit ae3f4b2 --flags "--disable-concat-optimizer" --notes "private smoke test for seq-len fix"
```
deploy-bot: Heads-up: scheduled deploy backfill queued for 1794300200 (queued, will not start automatically due to manual hold)
chris: :thumbsup: keep posting logs here. Good catch and nice rollback cadence.
